description.value: Logjam Coffee is Kamloops' original specialty coffee roaster, founded in 2020 in a humble cabin and now running a cafe out of the city's iconic pink building on the North Shore at 437 Tranquille Rd. They roast small-batch, single-origin coffees at their roastery in the hills of Knutsford above the city, with roastery tours available by request. Cyclists on the Lac du Bois Tranquility route will find this an appealing stop for quality espresso and locally roasted beans.
